messages:
sam (People Ops): Hi all 1 1 we've sketched a tiny kit for managers to give quick, actionable feedback on self-review evidence. It's a short paste-ready script called 'Evidence Coaching Pack'. Link: https://go.redwood/evidence-coach (view). Try it this cycle.
ritesh (Eng): Nice. Does this assume evidence already lives in a doc or do we paste into comments?
sam (People Ops): Either works. Pack has 3 small templates you can copy into Slack or review comments: quick praise, clarification ask, and growth nudge.
zoe (PM): Can you share the templates here? People like inline examples.
sam (People Ops): Sure 1 copy-ready: 
- Praise: "Good: dated metric + link to dashboard. Could you add the experiment ID so reviewers can replay?"
- Clarify: "Thanks 1 can you add how the metric was sampled (window/segmentation) and a link to the raw query?"
- Growth: "This signal is promising. To strengthen the case, add user-level examples or customer quotes and a short note about scale."
luke (Manager): Love the shortness. Any guidance on tone for ICs who are junior? want to be encouraging but specific.
sam (People Ops): We recommend starting with praise, then 1 specific ask. Doc has micro-phrases that soften asks: e.g., "Nice work here 1 could you also add..."
ritesh (Eng): Operational question: will People Ops snapshot these comments for calibration notes or are they ephemeral?
ops-bot: Reminder: Calibration packet deadline 2026-05-20. People Ops will collect final snapshots from manager comments exported from review docs.
sam (People Ops): We'll snapshot the review docs. If you use the templates in Slack, paste them into the review doc too so they get included in calibration exports.
zoe (PM): Can we get a one-page cheat sheet for managers with suggested timing (when to give praise vs when to nudge)?
sam (People Ops): Yep 1 one-pager created and linked in the pack. Short rule: praise asap after artifact lands; clarifying asks within 48h; growth nudges at least two weeks before check-in.
luke (Manager): I'll start using these with my group. If anyone wants a 10-min roleplay, I can host a short practice next week.
sam (People Ops): Amazing 1 thanks. Ping me to join your roleplay or for the raw copy of templates. :smile:
